revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the commercial owner framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. At the latest operating review, the business owner rejected treating this as a cosmetic rerun. The plan has to follow the commercial interpretation below, with the data-pack labels read literally. Maintenance added a special note for Machine 1. The first 1 second of Machine 1 overtime is covered by the normal window; more than that opens a 1.2-unit review burden on top of the existing overtime charge and sequencing plan. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
